name: Ogrekin Human Rogue 4/Fighter 3
body:
Ogrekin Human Rogue 4/Fighter 3
CR 8

XP 4,800
Male ogrekin human rogue 4/fighter 3
CE medium humanoid (giant) Init +1; Senses low light vision; Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 13, flat foot 15 (+1 deflection, +1 dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural)
hp 66 (4d8+3d10+4 favored class +28 CON)
Fort +8, Ref +6, Will +5; +1 vs. fear (Bravery 1)
Defensive Abilities Armor Training 1, Evasion, Trap Sense +1, Uncanny Dodge, Wind Stance

OFFENSE

Speed30 ft.
Melee +1 ogre hook +14/+9 (1d10+10/x3)
Special Attacks Sneak Attack +2d6, Bleeding Attack (Rogue Talent)

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 13, Con 18, Int 6, Wis 12, Cha 8
Base Atk +6; CMB +12; CMD 23
Feats Cleave, Dodge, Iron Will, Mobility, Power Attack, Spring Attack, Weapon Focus (Ogre Hook)
Skills Acrobatics + 10, Climb +15, Escape Artist +9, Perception + 11, Stealth +11
Languages Giant
SQ Deformities, Rogue Talent: Combat Trick (Wind Stance), Trapfinding
Gear +1 ogre hook, ring of protection +1, amulet of natural armor +1, tattered rags and tunic

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Deformities (Ex)

He has a +2 racial bonus on Fortitude saves and heals damage twice as fast from rest. He is also quite ugly (a huge, tumorous mass grows from the right side of his face) and suffers a -4 penalty on all Charisma-based checks.
